quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Lewisham
quests.blurb: The quiet carriage runs on shame and somebody on the the back of seven out of Lewisham has stopped feeling it. Ride it, see the crime, and apply the shame manually.

apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Jannali Shortcut
quests.blurb: Nine minutes between the shortcut at Jannali and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. Since the week of the show there has been a padlock on it, and it has been like that since the merge.

the long way round, so you understand what it costs

quests.title: Possession at Carlton

quests.title: The Exhibition Centre Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Exhibition Centre for 17 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

you cannot ask a favour empty-handed

the two arguing over the grass

quests.title: Whatever Is Under the Grey at Cowan
quests.blurb: One colour, grey, the same grey in Cowan as in every other suburb. I would like something of this one to exist afterwards, and they keep sending a different bloke.

show me

quests.title: The Hill Above Central Chalmers Street
quests.blurb: I drive past the same view above Central Chalmers Street eleven times a shift and I have never once stopped at it. You have got legs and no timetable. Go up and photograph what I have been driving past for 28 years.

steps.label: up the hill, the way the road does not go
the view I have never stopped for

quests.title: Contesting It at Tramway Avenue
quests.blurb: Done at Tramway Avenue on a wet Monday for something that is only an offence if a sign says so, and nobody will put it in writing. How do you photograph a thing not being somewhere? That is your problem now.

the one who tells you photography is not allowed here

quests.title: The Strip Outside Central
